initial_attempt: The eight-worker joblib process pool failed to deserialize a dispatched task (BrokenProcessPool). It did not produce a complete execution result.
completed_attempt: The same frozen plan was run with one worker, reusing the two receipt-verified pilot outputs and completing all 220 source replays.
output_integrity: Existing receipt-bearing outputs are checked against their inputs; unexpected partial files are preserved and cause failure rather than silent overwrite.
limitation: The serial fallback does not change the scientific design or turn the post-hoc comparison into an independent validation.
